quote: We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training.
claim: 作者还发现，使用学习到的位置嵌入与正弦位置编码两种版本结果几乎相同，选择正弦版本是因为它可能允许模型外推到比训练时更长的序列长度 [S3.SS5.p5]。

quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
claim: Transformer 在编码器和解码器中都使用堆叠的自注意力层与逐位置全连接层 [S3.p2]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property.
claim: 多头注意力在模型中有三种用法：编码器-解码器注意力、编码器自注意力，以及带掩码以保持自回归性质的解码器自注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
claim: 此外，自监督的 masked patch prediction 下 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
claim: 方法上，作者尽量遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，再把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，作者尽量遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，再把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中，卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，而将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: RAG answers 70% correctly using the 2016 index for 2016 world leaders and 68% using the 2018 index for 2018 world leaders.
claim: 通过替换非参数记忆索引，RAG 可更新世界知识：使用匹配年份索引时准确率约 70% 和 68%，不匹配时仅 12% 和 4% [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: For FEVER fact verification, we achieve results within 4.3% of state-of-the-art pipeline models which use strong retrieval supervision.
claim: 评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO 抽象问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实验证 [S1.p4]。

quote: Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策来源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策来源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
claim: 作者希望将参数与非参数记忆的混合模型从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We can fairly compare plain/residual networks that simultaneously have the same number of parameters, depth, width, and computational cost
claim: 捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，因此可以在参数、深度、宽度和计算开销相同的条件下公平比较普通网络与残差网络 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 作者在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: This indicates that the degradation problem is well addressed in this setting
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差明显更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题在此设置下得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，优于此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练精度反而下降（退化问题），而这不是由梯度消失/爆炸造成的 [S1.p4]。

quote: Currently, the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models
claim: DeepSeek-R1 的结构化输出能力仍不理想，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具提升输出性能 [S6.p3]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，则采用多阶段学习框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调 [S1.p3]。

quote: large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks. As a result, DeepSeek-R1 has not demonstrated a huge improvement over DeepSeek-V3 on software engineering benchmarks
claim: 在软件工程任务上，由于评估时间长影响 RL 效率，大规模 RL 未广泛应用，DeepSeek-R1 相比 DeepSeek-V3 未展现巨大提升 [S6.p7]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages
claim: 模型目前针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 模型在训练中自然学会增加思考时间，并涌现出反思、验证等高级推理行为 [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: We classify test-time scaling methods into 1) Sequential, where later computations depend on earlier ones
claim: 作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式扩展 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: Budget forcing leads to the best scaling as it has perfect controllability with a clear positive slope leading to strong performance.
claim: 数据选择方面，随机选择、选最长推理轨迹或只选最大多样性都会导致明显更差的表现（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而在 59K 全量数据池上训练相比 1K 选择没有显著增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 论文在三个推理基准上评估：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），默认温度 0、贪心解码、测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: we select benchmarks differing from our training data across three categories.
claim: 评估覆盖域内与分布外两类基准：域内包括 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 等数学推理基准 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]；分布外包括 OlympiadBench、新构建的中文多语言基准（CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool）以及 Minerva、GPQA 等多学科基准 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
claim: 消融显示：仅改变题目难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 提升至 51.5%，且仅在 Advanced-500 上微调的模型在 MATH500 上达 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；基础模型选择影响巨大，LIMO（基于 Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 的 9.2% 高出 54.1 个百分点，在 MATH500 上高出 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；模型规模上 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差距很小（95.6% vs 94.8%）[S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；数据量上仅 400 样本即将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3% vs 基座模型的 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Figure 7 and Figure 8 present the performance of models fine-tuned on different dataset sizes.
claim: 此外还做了消融研究，比较不同推理链质量、题目难度（Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500）、基础模型（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）以及数据量（400 到 2k）的影响 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: The model is trained for 15 epochs with a batch size of 64 examples
claim: 训练上对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做全参数 SFT，学习率 5.0e-6、余弦衰减、无 warmup、15 个 epoch、batch size 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: Actions should be simple and easy to understand for agents.
claim: 由此总结出若干设计原则，包括动作应简单易懂、紧凑高效，环境反馈应有信息量但简洁，guardrails 可缓解错误传播并加速恢复 [S2.p5]。

quote: SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例；主结果在完整测试集上报告，消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 的 300 个实例上进行 [S4.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，由 LM 和 ACI 组成，可与计算机交互解决真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 作者主张 LM 智能体代表一类新的终端用户，有其自身需求和能力，因此需要专门的 agent-computer interface [S2.p1]。

quote: The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
claim: 对比设置包括 Shell-only 基线，即让 LM 通过 Linux shell 进程交互解决问题 [S4.p4]。

quote: QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在几乎所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心策划的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4, a widely used LM pretraining corpus with more diverse text, and again show significant albeit smaller benefits.
claim: 大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的受益于推理的 token [S5.p2]。

quote: The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.
claim: 此外，在零样本 chain-of-thought 中，多数投票准确率（cot-maj@8）从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: we introduce a learned interpolation between the LM predictions with and without thoughts.
claim: mixing head 在带 thought 与不带 thought 的预测之间学习插值，以平滑过渡 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
claim: 此外，无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

quote: In contrast, a comparatively limited investment has been made in scaling the amount of computation used during inference.
claim: 作者指出，与训练计算量的持续投入相比，推理计算量的投入相对有限，用户和开发者通常限制模型只做一次尝试 [S1.p2]。

quote: We speculate that this due to Pythia being trained on less coding-specific data than Llama and Gemma.
claim: 例外是 Pythia 家族在 CodeContests 上即使 10,000 个样本也零覆盖，作者推测这与 Pythia 训练数据中编码数据较少有关 [S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: Although near-perfect coverage is achieved, all sample selection methods fail to reach the coverage upper bound and saturate before reaching 100 samples.
claim: 在没有自动验证器的 GSM8K 和 MATH 上，多数投票、奖励模型选择等样本选择方法在不到 100 个样本时就饱和，无法达到覆盖率上界 [S4.F7]。

quote: The success rate is therefore influenced both by the ability to generate correct samples for many problems (i.e. coverage), as well as the ability to identify these correct samples (i.e. precision).
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题独立生成多个候选解，并以覆盖率（至少一个生成样本解决的问题比例）和精度（识别正确样本的能力）作为核心指标 [S2.p1]。

quote: In the case of SWE-bench Lite, we solve 56% of problems, exceeding the single-attempt SOTA of 43%.
claim: 在五个任务上，覆盖率随样本预算增加而平滑提升；当所有模型只给一次尝试时 GPT-4o 在每个任务上都优于 Llama 和 DeepSeek 模型，但随着样本数增加，三个较弱模型都超过了 GPT-4o 的单次尝试性能 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: the model develops a broad set of skills and pattern recognition abilities at training time, and then uses those abilities at inference time to rapidly adapt to or recognize the desired task
claim: 作者希望探索一条途径，使语言模型在训练时获得广泛技能，并在推理时仅通过自然语言指令和少量示例快速适应或识别任务 [S1.p6]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
claim: 在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 少样本达到 86.4% 准确率，比此前最先进结果提高超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。

quote: we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
claim: 少样本设置从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
claim: 此外，GPT-3 在预训练阶段的样本效率仍然较差，其预训练所见文本远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。

quote: we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
claim: 然而，GPT-3 在部分任务上仍然表现不佳，如 ANLI、RACE 和 QuAC [S1.p13]。

quote: Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
claim: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练的 Llama 3，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估等类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: We use grouped query attention (GQA;) with 8 key-value heads to improve inference speed
claim: 相比 Llama 2 的小改动包括使用 8 个键值头的分组查询注意力、文档间自注意力掩码、128K tokens 词表和将 RoPE 基频提高到 500,000 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development.
claim: 作者指出，多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布 [abstract]。

quote: We implement window attention in the visual encoder to optimize inference efficiency
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 在视觉编码器中引入窗口注意力以优化推理效率，并引入动态 FPS 采样将动态分辨率扩展到时间维度 [S1.p4]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: 为此，Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: achieving optimal modality alignment remains an ongoing challenge that requires further advancements.
claim: 作者指出，将 CoT 推理应用于视觉语言模型的一个关键挑战是模型同时依赖文本和视觉模态，中间推理步骤可能未能充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

quote: passed through a two-layer multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to project them into a dimension that aligns with the text embeddings
claim: 此外，模型采用基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器，将空间相邻的四组 patch 特征拼接后经两层 MLP 投影到与文本嵌入对齐的维度 [S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: on composite OCR-related understanding benchmarks as OCRBench, InfoVQA
claim: 评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We achieve these wide capabilities using two foundation models: • Movie Gen Video.
claim: Movie Gen 使用两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。

quote: which consists of 1003 prompts that cover all the different testing aspects summarized above
claim: 文本到视频评测使用人工成对 A/B 测试，并公开包含 1003 条提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench，该基准比先前工作使用的提示集大 3 倍以上 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。

quote: A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
claim: Movie Gen 使用两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。

quote: Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).

claim: 论文采用PSPNet深度学习架构，对Cityscapes数据集中的精细和粗糙标注图像进行语义分割精度的对比分析 [abstract]。

quote: Moreover, this opens the perspectives to use deep neural networks for the preparation of such coarse GT datasets.
claim: 结果表明，对大多数重要类别，粗糙真值标注的语义图像分割平均精度值高于精细真值标注，而标准差则相反 [abstract]。

claim: 论文采用基于级联解码器的自编码器，所提串行解码器自编码器包括多级解码器架构及相关优化算法 [abstract]。

quote: This paper aims for image reconstruction of autoencoders, employs cascade decoders-based autoencoders, perfects the performance of image reconstruction, approaches gradually lossless image recovery, and provides solid theory and application basis for autoencoders-based image compression and compressed sensing.
claim: 论文旨在解决自编码器的图像重建问题，逐步逼近无损图像恢复，并为基于自编码器的图像压缩与压缩感知提供理论与应用基础 [abstract]。

quote: It is evaluated by the experimental results that the proposed autoencoders outperform the classical autoencoders in the performance of image reconstruction.
claim: 实验结果表明，所提自编码器在图像重建性能上优于经典自编码器 [abstract]。

quote: The main disadvantages of current autoencoders comprise the following several aspects: the research objective is not data reconstruction but feature representation; the performance evaluation of data recovery is neglected; it is hard to achieve lossless data reconstruction by pure autoencoders, even by pure deep learning.
claim: 论文旨在解决自编码器的图像重建问题，逐步逼近无损图像恢复，并为基于自编码器的图像压缩与压缩感知提供理论与应用基础 [abstract]。

quote: We use the standard, stochastic gradient descent procedure for training the dropout neural networks on mini-batches of training cases, but we modify the penalty term that is normally used to prevent the weights from growing too large.
claim: 训练采用标准随机梯度下降，但修改了惩罚项：不再惩罚整个权重向量的平方长度，而是对每个隐藏单元的输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束，则通过除法重新归一化该隐藏单元的权重 [p4]。

quote: This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels (see figure 1).
claim: 在 MNIST 上，50% dropout 配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的单独 L2 约束将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 像素 dropout 后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: This left us with 50 classes and 402,738 documents.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，使用 50 个类别、402,738 篇文档，每篇文档用 2000 个最频繁非停用词表示，训练了 2000-2000-1000-50 架构的网络 [A3.p2][A3.p3]。

claim: 作者明确指出，MatterSim 的预测能力本质上受训练数据理论水平的限制：模型基于 GGA-PBE 泛函（对部分材料加 Hubbard U 修正），这限制了其在更广泛系统和应用中的精度 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: We encounter convergence difficulties with elements such as Gd and Eu, particularly in off-equilibrium structures where self-consistent cycles fail to converge, or energies vary significantly for two structures with nearly identical atomic positions.
claim: 此外，对 Gd 和 Eu 等元素存在收敛困难，特别是在非平衡结构中自洽循环无法收敛或能量对近乎相同原子位置的结构变化显著，这些计算被排除在研究之外 [S5.p1]。

quote: However, the property of a potential candidate material not only depends on its chemical composition and corresponding near-equilibrium atomic structure, but also on thermodynamic conditions including temperature and pressure.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：材料性质不仅取决于化学组成和近平衡原子结构，还取决于温度和压力等热力学条件，因此需要在远超基态或局域极小值的巨大构型空间上保持高预测精度，而现有数据库和模型难以满足这一要求 [S1.p2]。

quote: In this work, we opt to use two primary architectures, M3GNet and Graphormer as the backbones for MatterSim.
claim: 模型骨干采用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种架构，其中 M3GNet 数据效率高、推理快，Graphormer 基于 Transformer、可扩展性更强但推理更慢、显存需求更高 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: For both sections, Orb models set a new state-of-the art across the primary metric (F1), and are generally superior across other metrics.
claim: 在 Matbench Discovery 上，Orb 模型在主要指标 F1 上刷新了最优结果，并在其他指标上总体更优，尤其具有高精度 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Orb demonstrates excellent stability, achieving the maximum 300ps for all molecules, putting it on par with NequIP and ahead of all other baseline models.
claim: 在 MD17 分子特定微调中，Orb 对所有分子达到最大 300 ps 的稳定性，与 NequIP 相当并领先其他基线 [S3.SS4.SSSx1.Px1.p1]；零样本评估中，仅用 MPtraj 训练的 Orb 表现最好，且优于许多分子特定基线 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px1.p1]。

quote: we follow previous work in combining MPtraj, the dataset constructed from the Materials Project and used to train CHGNet, with Alexandria
claim: 微调阶段则使用 MPtraj 与 Alexandria 等一致设置的数据 [S2.SS3.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

quote: Orb models have especially high precision
claim: 在 Matbench Discovery 上，Orb 模型在主要指标 F1 上刷新了最优结果，并在其他指标上总体更优，尤其具有高精度 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: it is hard to make a robust judgement of superiority from a sample size of four simulations.
claim: 作者指出，零样本 MD17 评估仅基于四个模拟，样本量小，难以对模型优越性做出稳健判断，且加入 Alexandria 后性能下降可能在大样本下不具统计显著性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: The throughput of transmitting, processing, and decoding the syndrome information in each cycle must keep pace with the fast error correcting cycle time of 1.1 µs.
claim: 此外，作者实现了实时解码系统，采用分块流式解码算法以跟上1.1微秒的纠错周期 [S5.p1][S5.F4]。

quote: Averaging over bit- and phase-flip repetition codes, we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11
claim: 在重复码中，作者获得Λ=8.4±0.1，逻辑错误率远低于10^-6，但在码距d≥15时偏离指数抑制，出现约10^-10的表观逻辑错误地板 [S4.p3]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现低于阈值的量子纠错，即物理错误率低于临界阈值从而使逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制 [S1.p1]。

quote: Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
claim: 作者还使用72量子比特处理器运行距离-29重复码，进行1000个纠错循环、2×10^7次采样，总计2×10^10个纠错循环、5.5小时处理器执行时间 [S4.p2]。

quote: Despite realizing below-threshold surface codes, orders of magnitude remain between present logical error rates and the requirements for practical quantum computation.
claim: 作者还指出，当前逻辑错误率与实用量子计算需求之间仍相差多个数量级 [S4.p1]。

quote: However, we caution against over-interpretation of this result, since at least some of the $\left(w_{0},w_{a}\right)$ models preferred by our analysis could be mapped to quintessence models which reproduce the observable quantities $D_{M}/r_{d}$ and $D_{H}/r_{d}$ to high precision even though they do not violate the null energy condition at any redshift
claim: 作者还警告不要过度解读 (w0,wa) 结果，因为分析偏好的至少部分 (w0,wa) 模型可能映射到不违反零能量条件的精质模型，或可由修改引力或多场模型获得，是否能在分析偏好的完整 (w0,wa) 范围内找到避免幽灵区的映射仍有待探索 [S5.SS2.p9]。

quote: Using BAO we can test for dark energy dynamics and spatial curvature, and in combination with other probes constrain the Hubble constant, the sum of neutrino masses, and the number of light species.
claim: BAO 作为宇宙学探针，对宇宙膨胀历史敏感且系统误差控制良好，可用于检验暗能量动力学和空间曲率，并与其他探针结合约束哈勃常数、中微子质量总和及轻种类粒子数 [S1.p5]。

quote: Overall, this analysis of the DESI Data Release 1 relies on over $6$ million unique redshifts, more than twice the number of redshifts considered in the final SDSS cosmological analysis.
claim: 分析基于 DESI 第一年观测（DR1）数据，涵盖 0.1<z<4.2 红移范围内超过 600 万个河外天体，包括亮星系（BGS）、亮红星系（LRG）、发射线星系（ELG）、类星体（QSO）和莱曼α森林示踪物 [abstract][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2]。

quote: All Bayesian inference is performed using the Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler in cobaya.
claim: 分析使用 Metropolis-Hastings MCMC 采样器 cobaya 进行贝叶斯推断，在平坦 ΛCDM 模型中采样 Ωm 和 rdh，或结合外部数据时采样 Ωm、H0 和物理重子密度 ωb [S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: Such tensions, if not due to unaccounted systematics, may indicate new physics beyond $\Lambda$ CDM.
claim: 研究动机在于：当前关键宇宙学参数约束大体与 ΛCDM 一致，但暗能量动力学尚未被严格检验，且 ΛCDM 框架内出现了统计显著性不等的张力（如哈勃张力和 σ8 张力），这些张力若非未计入的系统误差，可能指示超出 ΛCDM 的新物理 [S1.p3]。

quote: we assume a bolometric luminosity of $L_{\rm bol}=10^{46}~{\rm erg~s}^{-1}$ as the incident radiation from the AGN, and calculate the monochromatic luminosity at rest-frame $1450~{\rm\AA}$ using a bolometric correction factor of $f_{\rm bol,UV}=4.4$.
claim: 在红外部分，模型计算了 z=4 到 z=7 的 SED，假设 AGN 入射辐射的 bolometric luminosity 为 L_bol=10^46 erg s^-1，并采用 f_bol,UV=4.4 计算静止系 1450 Å 的单色光度 [S2.p9]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 作者提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD SED 模型，假设一个具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射被嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似于猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境中的致密区域 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。

quote: In the high density region ( $n_{0}\gtrsim 10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$), the NIR SED is influenced by re-emission from hot dust grains heated by the AGN, resulting in a steeper optical-to-NIR slope that is inconsistent with the observational requirement.
claim: 参数分析显示，高密度区（n_0≳10^3 cm^-3）的近红外 SED 受热尘埃再发射影响，光学到近红外斜率过陡，与观测要求不符 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: This model, unlike the typical AGN hot torus models, can produce a infrared SED flattening that is consistent with LRD observations through JWST MIRI.
claim: 在红外部分，与典型 AGN 热尘埃环模型不同，该模型能产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的 SED 平坦化 [S5.p2]。

quote: Their unique v-shape spectral feature characterized by a red optical continuum and a UV excess in the rest frame challenges us to discern the relative contributions of the galaxy and AGN.
claim: 论文要解决的核心问题是：LRD 的 v 形光谱特征（静止系紫外过剩与红色光学连续谱）究竟来自星系还是 AGN，以及其红外 SED 为何与典型热尘埃环模型预期不符 [abstract][S1.p3]。

quote: The production of $t\bar{t}$ events was modeled using the Powheg Box v2 heavy-quark (hvq) generator at next-to-leading order (NLO) precision in QCD and the events were interfaced to either Pythia 8.230 or Herwig 7.2.1 to model the parton shower and hadronization.
claim: 信号和背景过程通过蒙特卡洛事件模拟建模，顶夸克对产生使用 Powheg Box v2 重夸克产生器在 NLO 精度下模拟，并接口 Pythia 8.230 或 Herwig 7.2.1 模拟部分子簇射和强子化 [S1.SS1.p4]。

quote: In both of the validation regions, with no entanglement signal, the measurements are found to agree with the predictions from different MC setups within the uncertainties.
claim: 在两个无纠缠信号的验证区，测量结果与不同蒙特卡洛设置的预测在不确定度内一致，验证了测量方法 [S1.SS4.p1]。

quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
claim: 论文旨在探索最高可及能量尺度上的量子纠缠，此前纠缠在从微观到宏观的广泛系统中已被观测，但在最高能量尺度上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。

quote: In this Article, the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement, in proton–proton ( $pp$) collision events recorded with the ATLAS detector at a center-of-mass energy of 13 TeV.
claim: 研究利用顶夸克与反顶夸克之间的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠效应，在 ATLAS 探测器记录的质心能量 13 TeV 的质子-质子碰撞事件中进行 [S1.p2]。

quote: The observed result in the region with $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV establishes the formation of entangled $t\bar{t}$ states. This constitutes the first observation of entanglement in a quark–antiquark pair.
claim: 在信号区，观测和预期显著性相对于纠缠极限均远超五个标准差，且不依赖于用于将纠缠极限修正到基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。

quote: First, we investigate the impact of injecting quasiparticles into the superconductor as indicated in Fig. 5 a
claim: 作者还在器件 A 的第二次测量和器件 B 上重复了类似测量，并进行了注入准粒子、断开量子点与纳米线连接等对照实验 [S3.p11][S3.p12][S3.p13]。

quote: we observe oscillations in the kurtosis $K(C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}})$ of the $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ time trace with a period of $1.7(\pm 0.2)\text{\,}\mathrm{mT}$
claim: 器件 A 的相关区间在 B∥≈1.8 T 和 V_WP1≈-1.832 V 附近，观测到 kurtosis 以 1.7(±0.2) mT 周期振荡，与 h/2e 磁通周期一致 [S3.p2]。

quote: we tune up the TQDI and perform a sequence of nearly $1.5\times 10^{4}$ consecutive measurements of the resonator response, each with an integration time of $4.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$, thereby recording a time trace of total length $67\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$.
claim: 作者对器件 A 进行了约 1.5×10^4 次连续测量，每次积分时间 4.5 µs，总时长 67 ms，并扫描面外磁场 B⊥ 和 V_QD2 以研究干涉环磁通依赖 [S3.p1]。

quote: Progress in this direction was made in Ref., which reported coherent transport through a gate-defined nanowire island in an Aharonov-Bohm interferometer, albeit in a regime that does not allow qubit readout.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现对 Majorana 零能模共享费米子宇称的单次干涉测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [abstract][S1.p2]。

quote: by fitting to a model of trivial Andreev states, we have tightly constrained the properties that such states would have to have in order to be consistent with our data.
claim: 作者将 h/2e 周期双模振荡和随机电报信号解释为费米子宇称的切换，并估计宇称测量误差概率约为 1% [S3.p3][S5.p1]。

quote: the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔融盐热物理数据，且此前 Buckingham 势对熔融 LiF 黏度的预测存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
claim: 作者认为这些结果对“经典势熔点偏差导致黏度偏移”的假说提供了一定支持，但其他效应如体系大小和缺乏界面也可能有贡献 [S4.p2]。

quote: We show $g(r)$ for each pair at the approximate melting temperature of each potential.
claim: 在结构方面，作者分析了各势在各自近似熔点温度下的偏径向分布函数 g(r) 及其导出的结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5]。

quote: This leads to the absence of long-wavelength and low-frequency phonons with large displacement amplitudes which destabilise the solid structure and likewise encourage melting.
claim: 作者指出，从晶体结构逐步加热来确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件排除了实验中的自由表面与界面，且 MD 体系尺寸较小，缺少能促进熔化的长波长、低频声子；更可靠的方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。

quote: gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.
claim: 作者指出，从晶体结构逐步加热来确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件排除了实验中的自由表面与界面，且 MD 体系尺寸较小，缺少能促进熔化的长波长、低频声子；更可靠的方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。

quote: It can be seen that both ACF and GPS predicted effectively $\sim 85\%$ of the dataset while our model predicted the entire dataset.
claim: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声与无噪声样本上均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队的结果，且比 ACF 和 GPS 更稳健；ACF 和 GPS 仅能有效预测约 85% 的数据集，而 LightPred 能预测全部样本 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: We acknowledge that shuffling quarters (90 Days) might remove phase information and potentially hinder the detection of long periods.
claim: 作者承认，打乱季度（90 天）的增强可能移除相位信息并潜在地妨碍长周期探测 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: The model utilizes a dual-branch architecture combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer components to capture temporal and global data features.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以捕捉光变曲线中的时间与全局特征 [abstract][S6.p1]。

quote: Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.
claim: 作者还确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

quote: This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 130868 条满足 8 个连续季度的样本进行 SSL 训练与推断，并最终得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。
